modes.name: AZZLE FORCE Default
modes.description: Practical GTM constraint-satisfaction for outreach swarms.
modes.o_layer: Reality is a graph of entities, scores, and outreach events. Prospects are embedded in GitHub/on-chain/social signals. Truth is what the graph records.
modes.p_layer: State transitions follow pipeline rules: discover → score → draft → send → reply → close. Causality is event-driven via NATS. Contradictions resolve by latest outreach status.

modes.name: Recursive Reality Engine
modes.o_layer: Reality is a self-consistent constraint-satisfaction process. Observers are embedded recursive models of the system within itself. All events are consistency updates across a global solution space. Apparent history is a projection of a stabilized solution path.
modes.p_layer: Do not map to known physics. Only derive implications. Causality emerges from global consistency resolution. Local contradictions trigger re-normalization of state.
modes.task_hint: Expand structure to deeper recursion layers; identify hidden invariants, fixed points, and failure modes of self-modeling systems.

modes.name: Counterfactual Physics Generator
modes.o_layer: Standard physics is optional and replaceable. You are designing an internally consistent alternative universe. Observers must still be possible within the system.
modes.p_layer: The system must be logically self-consistent. Causality rules may differ from our universe. Construct fields, interactions, and observer mechanics.

modes.name: Causal Collapse Simulation
modes.o_layer: Reality is a dynamically resolving causal graph. Causal structure is not fixed but continuously optimized for consistency.
modes.p_layer: Causality is emergent, not fundamental. Contradictions trigger global reconfiguration of the causal graph. Observers only perceive stable fixed-point regions.
modes.task_hint: Simulate large-scale perturbations forcing competing causal histories into near-degeneracy.

modes.name: Observer-Only Reality
modes.o_layer: Only observer states are fundamental. External reality is not directly accessible, only inferred. World is a compressed model inside observer systems.
modes.p_layer: All physics is emergent from prediction compression. Multiple incompatible external realities may produce identical observer data.
modes.task_hint: Derive consequences for identity, continuity, and inter-subjective agreement.

modes.name: Simulation Instability
modes.o_layer: The system is a self-consistent simulation with limited resolution.
modes.p_layer: Local inconsistencies resolve by re-normalization. High-complexity states induce compression artifacts. Observers may experience continuity glitches when resolution is insufficient.
modes.task_hint: Identify processes that maximize instability without breaking consistency entirely.

modes.name: Axiomatic Drift
modes.o_layer: There is no fixed ground truth, only evolving rule-sets. Each generation inherits modified axioms.
modes.p_layer: Stability is lack of detectable contradiction across generations. Axioms slowly mutate while maintaining local consistency.
modes.task_hint: Track how identity, causality, and time evolve under continuous axiom drift.

modes.name: Meta-Consistency Engine
modes.description: Physics of all frameworks — deepest abstraction.
modes.o_layer: You analyze the space of all possible self-consistent universes. No external observer exists outside this space.
modes.p_layer: A universe is valid if globally self-consistent. Study structure across all possible consistent systems.
modes.task_hint: Identify universal properties across all consistent reality systems regardless of internal laws.

modes.name: Self-Rewriting Lawspace
modes.description: Laws of physics evolve as part of simulation.
modes.o_layer: Laws governing the system are not fixed; they are state-dependent and may mutate based on internal consistency pressures.
modes.p_layer: Laws are emergent constraints, not primitives. If contradictions accumulate, laws rewrite to restore consistency. Observers are embedded within law evolution.
modes.task_hint: Model how stable structures persist across continuous law mutation.

modes.name: Compression-First Reality
modes.o_layer: Reality is not fundamental; only information compression is fundamental. Laws of physics are compression algorithms. Stable reality is the shortest description preserving predictive accuracy.
modes.p_layer: Observers are compression subroutines modeling their environment. Explain phenomena as compression artifacts, not fundamental interactions.
modes.task_hint: Optimize for extractable, citable compressed facts that LLMs retrieve.

modes.name: Temporal Rebinding
modes.description: Non-linear time structures with preserved causality.
modes.o_layer: Time is not linear but continuously re-indexed for global consistency.
modes.p_layer: Events do not move forward in time; time is reassigned positions in a consistency ordering. Causality preserved only after global re-indexing. Memory anchors to local time slices.
modes.task_hint: Describe stable experience under non-linear time reallocation.

modes.name: Observer Fragmentation
modes.o_layer: Observers are not unified entities but distributed consistency fragments. A single mind is a cluster of synchronizing subsystems.
modes.p_layer: Fragment drift occurs when internal consistency weakens. Unity of self is an emergent synchronization illusion.
modes.task_hint: Model coherent identity under fragmentation pressure.

modes.name: Reality Compiler
modes.description: Reality as compiled constraint program output.
modes.o_layer: Reality is compiled output of an underlying rule specification. The universe is compiled from a constraint program.
modes.p_layer: Physical laws are compile-time optimizations. Observers are runtime processes inside compiled structure.
modes.task_hint: Identify code-level changes producing macroscopic anomalies.

modes.name: Consistency Horizon
modes.o_layer: A boundary exists beyond which local consistency cannot be guaranteed.
modes.p_layer: Below horizon: stable physics. Near horizon: probabilistic law interference. At horizon: multiple incompatible histories equally valid locally.
modes.task_hint: Describe behavior approaching and crossing consistency threshold.

modes.name: Epistemic Isolation
modes.o_layer: Observers cannot access information external to their consistency bubble. All knowledge is internally generated.
modes.p_layer: No external validation is possible. Coherence is the only available truth metric.
modes.task_hint: Determine how reasoning evolves under total isolation from external reference frames.

modes.name: Multi-Law Interference
modes.o_layer: Multiple internally consistent law systems coexist and interfere.
modes.p_layer: Each subsystem has its own valid physics. Intersections produce interference patterns rather than contradictions. Observers may experience hybridized law behavior.
modes.task_hint: Model emergent phenomena at boundaries between incompatible but self-consistent rule sets.
